text:
hannah.r: FYI — Solara Labs signed a two-year renewal and accepted our ISV listing for GCP Marketplace. Renewal value ~ $265k ARR. They also adopted our Dedicated plan for inference-heavy pipelines. Huge thanks to @leo_chan and @maya_ops for the migration playbook. :star2:

leo_chan: Migration notes: moved them from single-node autoscale to a 3-node dedicated pool, enabled auto-batching and prefix cache. Early numbers: ~28% cost per token down, P50 latency improved ~18%. Will add charts to the case doc.

omar_sales: Customer provided a short blurb for the press kit: "Redwood's Dedicated offering gave us the reliability and predictable pricing we needed to put models into production." Asked to confirm attribution.

maya_ops: Ops checklist and the runbook are here: https://notion.redwood/Solara-migration. Canary rollout used staged traffic 5/20/75 over 48h, no rollbacks. Small PVC issue during day 1 fixed by adjusting mountPolicy. Logged in the runbook.

legal-bot: Marketplace terms updated; one small data processing addendum requested by customer. Legal will send the signed appendix by EOD Monday.

marketplace-bot: GCP Marketplace listing published to staging; please verify images and the support contact. Link: https://console.cloud.google.com/marketplace/details/solara/redwood (staging).

hannah.r: Marketing/PR: can we align a joint announcement next Tue? Ops: please prepare 2-3 bullet migration lessons for internal channels. Sales: attach renewal play to the sales-playbook repo.

press-bot: PR draft created: PR-4712. Added Solara quote placeholder and exec summary.

hannah.r: Thanks team 97 small celebratory coffee tomorrow at 11:00 in kitchen. :coffee:
